findings.title: README tells users to clear ECL110 MQTT topics that already ship empty
findings.claim: README.md L894-895 and L214-215 state both ECL110 MQTT topics ship non-empty and must be cleared by a user without an ECL110, but all three ECL110 topic options ship with an empty-string default, so there is nothing to clear and no failed publish can occur.
findings.mechanism: config_flow._OPTION_FIELDS builds ecl110_displace_set_topic, ecl110_command_topic and ecl110_state_topic with empty-string defaults; _publish_ecl110 returns early when both publish topics are empty. docs/ecl110.md L79-83 documents the correct behaviour; README contradicts it; tests/nightly_ha.py:2531 repeats the false premise.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: rewrite README.md L894-895/L214-215 to the docs/ecl110.md wording; drop the stale 'defaults are non-empty' clause from tests/nightly_ha.py:2531

findings.title: Two of three shipped blueprints default to entity ids this build never creates
findings.claim: Two of the three blueprints README.md L673-684 presents as importable worked examples default their sensor input to an entity id the sensor platform does not build, contradicting docs/automations.md L6-7.
findings.mechanism: sensor.py:365 pins every object id as f"sensor.heat_pump_optimizer_{translation_key}"; these two sensors' translation keys carry a cost_ token. The blueprint defaults name sensor.heat_pump_optimizer_power_headroom and sensor.heat_pump_optimizer_current_electricity_price, which no platform builds.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: add the missing cost_ token to the two blueprint default: ids, or delete the default: keys so the field opens empty

findings.title: Documented entity-id prefix does not follow the entry name
findings.claim: docs/automations.md L7-11 and two blueprint descriptions tell users the entity prefix follows the entry name and to change it if they named theirs differently, but sensor.py:365 pins heat_pump_optimizer regardless of entry title.
findings.mechanism: HeatPumpOptimizerSensorBase assigns self.entity_id from the translation key before the entity is added; the token heat_pump_optimizer is a hard-coded literal, deliberately. docs/dashboard-card.md L659-661 attributes the prefix to has_entity_name, which is not the mechanism in use.
